description: This file defines a command-line utility function `cmd__genrandom` that generates reproducible random data based on a seed string and an optional size parameter. It is used for creating test files with deterministic content, inspired by the POSIX.1-2001 rand() implementation example.

methods.name: int cmd__genrandom(int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Generates a sequence of pseudo-random bytes based on a seed string and optional size parameter, and outputs them to stdout.
